verification.note: Refresh of 18 Oct 2026. official_url now points at the guide itself: the PDF served from AITI's guide-books page (39 pages; stored in this run as an official source, identical to the copy stored as the record's secondary source on 12 Oct 2026). It confirms the title, AITI and the working group as authors, the guide's non-binding character and that it may be amended with prior notice. AITI's press release of 11 April 2025 (aiti.gov.bn, in Malay and English; copy of 12 Oct 2026, unchanged on 18 Oct 2026), now the secondary_url, gives the release date and the Malay title. The guide itself gives no date other than a copyright line of 2024, so the date rests on the release, an announcement, and the record is level B. AITI's AI governance and ethics page (aiti.gov.bn, stored in this run) gives the working group's formation in May 2024 with 25 members, the consultation paper of 9 July 2024 with 17 responses, and download links for the guide and a 'Second Edition' shown only in a third-party flipbook viewer (flowpaper.com) that exposes no text, so its date and changes are unknown.

judgment.status_reasoning: AITI released the guide on 11 April 2025 and still serves it; the guide says it may be amended periodically with prior notice. AITI's governance page also lists a 'Second Edition' whose text and date cannot be read, so whether it replaces this edition is open. Published (non-binding, current).
judgment.date_reasoning: 11 April 2025 is the date of AITI's release of the guide. The guide's own text gives only a copyright year, 2024, which is not the year of release, so rule 7b gives no usable date from the instrument and the release date stays, with alt-official evidence (level B).
judgment.scope_reasoning: A government AI governance and ethics guide with safety, security and risk-management content; in scope with no note; unchanged.

open_questions: AITI's AI governance page lists a 'Second Edition' of the guide, shown only in a flipbook viewer without readable text; its date and whether it replaces the edition stored are unknown.

The guide stored is in English only; the Malay title appears only in AITI's bilingual press release, and no Malay text of the guide is stored. Whether 'language: English, Malay' should be 'English' is open.
